key_contribution: The International Journal for Educational Integrity is an open-access, peer-reviewed journal specifically focused on advancing research and practice in educational integrity. It publishes articles addressing plagiarism, cheating, academic misconduct, and integrity in learning contexts. The journal provides a platform for scholars to discuss emerging challenges like AI-assisted cheating and explores detection methods and prevention strategies for maintaining academic integrity in higher education.
relevance_to_ai_integrity: Highly specialized in academic integrity with extensive coverage of AI topics. Recent key papers include: 'Testing of detection tools for AI-generated text' (2023) - evaluation of limitations of AI detectors on GPT-3.5 vs GPT-4; 'Evaluating the efficacy of AI content detection tools in differentiating between human and AI-generated text' (2023) - demonstrates inconsistencies and false positives; 'Linking artificial intelligence facilitated academic misconduct to existing prevention frameworks' (2023); 'Algorithmic-driven writing and academic integrity: exploring educators' practices, perceptions, and policies in AI era' (2024); 'The great detectives: humans versus AI detectors in catching large language model-generated medical writing' (2024); 'Global Trends in Education: Artificial Intelligence, Postplagiarism, and Future-focused Learning for 2025 and Beyond' (2025) - advocates shift from detection toward validity-driven assessment. ISSN: 1833-2595. Impact Factor (2024): 6.9 (5-year: 5.8). CiteScore: 4.1. SJR: 1.405. Founding year: 2005. Open access. Quartile: Q1.
